command_line:
set +e
sed '/^[[:space:]]*docker[[:space:]]*:/d; /^[[:space:]]*singularity[[:space:]]*:/d; /^[[:space:]]*conda[[:space:]]*:/d' /software/atac-seq-pipeline/atac.wdl > atac.noruntime.wdl
cat > q1_input.json <<EOF
{
  "atac.pipeline_type" : "atac",
  "atac.genome_tsv" : "https://storage.googleapis.com/encode-pipeline-genome-data/genome_tsv/v4/hg38.tsv",
  "atac.fastqs_rep1_R1" : ["/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79144353/inputs/dataset_2d599c57-8b14-4fe1-9ade-9dc05b36557a.dat"],
  "atac.fastqs_rep1_R2" : ["/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79144353/inputs/dataset_817c85ac-7fad-4bf2-85ed-d8cc5a9156ff.dat"],
  "atac.paired_end" : true,
  "atac.auto_detect_adapter" : true,
  "atac.title" : "encode.atac.pipeline.q1",
  "atac.description" : "Paired-end human ATAC-seq reads from encode.atac.pipeline.q1"
}
EOF
java -Dconfig.file=/dev/null -jar "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79144353/inputs/dataset_2ac0cb03-4620-4750-91ad-0e47d0ba0137.dat" run atac.noruntime.wdl -i q1_input.json > cromwell.stdout 2> cromwell.stderr
run_status=$$?
qc_path=""
if find cromwell-executions -name qc.json -type f | head -1 > qc_path.txt; then
  qc_path=`cat qc_path.txt`
fi
if [ -n "$$qc_path" ] && [ -s "$$qc_path" ]; then
  cp "$$qc_path" final_qc.json
else
  echo '{}' > final_qc.json
fi
python3 - <<'PY' > extracted_nopt.txt 2> extract.stderr
import json, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('final_qc.json')
try:
    data = json.loads(p.read_text())
except Exception as e:
    print('PARSE_ERROR', e)
    raise SystemExit(0)
matches = []
def walk(x, path=''):
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        for k, v in x.items():
            p2 = path + '/' + str(k)
            if str(k) == 'N_opt' or ('N_opt' in str(k) and 'idr' in p2.lower()):
                matches.append((p2, v))
            walk(v, p2)
    elif isinstance(x, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(x):
            walk(v, path + '/' + str(i))
walk(data)
for path, value in matches:
    print(f'{path}\t{value}')
PY
{
  echo 'run_status' "$$run_status"
  echo 'qc_path' "$$qc_path"
  echo '--- input json ---'
  sed -n '1,120p' q1_input.json
  echo '--- N_opt candidates ---'
  sed -n '1,120p' extracted_nopt.txt
  echo '--- cromwell stdout tail ---'
  tail -160 cromwell.stdout
  echo '--- cromwell stderr tail ---'
  tail -120 cromwell.stderr
  echo '--- qc keys preview ---'
  python3 - <<'PY'
import json
try:
    data=json.load(open('final_qc.json'))
    print(type(data).__name__)
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        for k in list(data.keys())[:80]: print(k)
except Exception as e:
    print('qc_preview_error', e)
PY
} > run_summary.txt
exit 0
